lebanon-2009.notes: Our copy (5 pages of acmacpc.org, the Arab and North Africa regional's site) is the 2009 archive page of that regional, held in Alexandria, Egypt 22-24 November 2009; Lebanon appears only in its list of nine participating countries. It is not the Lebanese Collegiate Programming Contest of 3 July 2009. Needs a new capture.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader called the copy an empty Facebook shell; our copy is the ACM ACPC site's 2009 archive page of the Arab and North Africa regional contest.
sources.evidence: The archive page is headed "2009 ACM Arab & North Africa Regional Contest", hosted in Alexandria, Egypt on 22-24 November 2009, with 45 teams from nine countries; it does not describe the Lebanese Collegiate Programming Contest.

lebanon-2018.notes: Our copy holds the LAU news archive for 2018 (150 pages); the article at the seed address (its address mentions computer science students and the battle of the brains) and the Facebook page were not saved. Needs a new capture.

sources.evidence: The 150 saved pages are LAU News articles and listings of 2018; the only contest-related item is a headline link "Computer Science Students Win “Battle of the Brains”" in the 2018 index, and that article is not in our copy.

lebanon-2019.notes: Article gives only first, second and sixth place, so kept as report without rankings. Date 2019-10-04 differs from the catalogue's 2019-10-05; the article also says 'two days'. The browser-tab title of the page is 'The Lebanese Collegiate Programming Competition LCPC | Beirut Arab University'; the page heading is the first part.

sources.evidence: The page is a BAU news item dated 04 October 2019 reporting the LCPC held on October 4, 2019, with 37 teams and the placings of LAU, AUB and BAU.
